defaultGreeting: Hello, how can I help you?
intro: Assistants for customers on your website, without signing in. Each knows only what you choose for it.
confirmDelete: Delete the assistant {{name}}? Links and widgets on websites will stop working.
name: Name in the link (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens)
title: Company name for customers
tokens: Monthly token limit (empty = only the organization's limit)
knowledgeHint: Documents and folders the assistant searches. A chosen folder includes everything added to it later.
memoryHint: Facts the assistant always gets (for example opening hours).
skillsHint: The organization's procedures the assistant may follow.
skillsEmpty: The organization has no skills of its own.
snippetHint: Put this on your website (for example in www/index.html before </body>):
unavailable: The assistant isn't available right now.
footer: Answers come from artificial intelligence and may be wrong. Run by Osiris.
